test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 19 Jun, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution: The correct answer is **"Practice."** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The reason to use **"practice"** in the blank is that it completes the phrase** "funeral practice"** to indicate the customary or usual method or procedure for handling funerals. (रिक्त स्थान में **"Practice"** का उपयोग करने का कारण यह है कि यह अंत्येष्टि से निपटने के लिए पारंपरिक या सामान्य विधि या प्रक्रिया को इंगित करने के लिए "funeral practice" वाक्यांश को पूरा करता है।) • **"Practice"** refers to a habitual or customary action or behavior, which fits appropriately in the context of discussing how funerals are conducted. • The correct answer is Option 4. Correct paragraph: Alkaline hydrolysis is rare today as a funeral **practice**__ for humans. Offered to the public for the first time just over a ______ (2) ______ ago, it is now permitted and regulated in 26 U.S. states, and practiced ______ (3) ______ in North America, where it remains unfamiliar to most people who ______ (4) ______ a loved one or who are thinking about what could ______ (5) ______ to their own bodies when they die. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • **Activity: **a situation in which there is a lot of action or movement. (सक्रियता, क्रियाशीलता; गतिविधियों से पूर्ण स्थिति) • **Proceeding: **to continue doing something; to continue being done. (कुछ करना जारी रखना; कोई बात होते रहना) • **Judgement: **the ability to form opinions or to make sensible decisions. (सम्‍मति स्थिर करने या बुद्धिमतापूर्ण निर्णय करने की योग्‍यता; निर्णय क्षमता) 22d:Td01, The correct answer is "decade."
